en.app.name: KK AI助手
en.brand.subtitle: Local agent
en.sessions.title: Chats
en.keyWarn: No API key for the current provider. Open Settings (top right) or add one to .env.
en.keyWarnNamed: No API key for {provider}. Open Settings (top right) to paste one (takes effect immediately), or add it to .env.
en.composer.placeholder: Ask anything… Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
en.composer.hint: Tools run in the local workspace sandbox — not a secure isolation boundary. Medium-risk commands need approval. You can upload images for vision.
en.rail.keyMissing: This provider’s key is not saved
en.settings.keyPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the saved key
en.settings.xaiHint: Keys are written only to local data/settings.json and never shown again. Get one at https://console.x.ai
en.settings.openaiHint: OPENAI_API_KEY in the environment is also accepted. Get one at https://platform.openai.com
en.settings.anthropicHint: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the environment is also accepted. Get one at https://console.anthropic.com
en.settings.modelHint: You can also pick one in the Models rail. The change applies to the next message.
en.settings.localBrowser: Allow the browser tool to reach localhost / private networks (off by default)
en.settings.mcpHint: Loaded from data/mcp.json. You can copy mcp.example.json from the repo root.
en.routines.intro: Cron uses Asia/Shanghai. When due, the prompt is sent to the assistant in the background.
en.routines.name: Name
en.routines.promptPlaceholder: Use web_search to summarize today’s AI news into workspace/daily.md
en.empty.title: What do you want to do today?
en.empty.body: This is a working KK AI助手. The model can call tools in a loop until it has a final answer.
en.demo.search.text: Search how the xAI Grok API does function calling
en.demo.write.text: Write a notes.txt in the workspace with three to-do lines
en.demo.memory.text: Remember: my name is Xiaokang, and I prefer concise answers
en.demo.web.text: Fetch https://example.com and summarize the page
en.demo.browser.text: Open https://example.com in the browser, take a snapshot, then summarize the page
en.demo.image.text: Generate an ink-wash painting of a panda sitting in a bamboo grove
en.demo.sub.text: Use a sub-agent to search the official Playwright install steps and write them to workspace/playwright-notes.txt
en.approval.title: Approval required
en.approval.timeout: Auto-denied if you take no action in about {seconds}s
en.mcp.empty: Nothing configured. Copy mcp.example.json to data/mcp.json and refresh.
en.auth.title: Access token
en.auth.hint: This server requires an access token. Enter it to continue.
en.settings.accessTokenHint: Protects LAN access. After it is set, APIs require the token. It is never shown again. You can also set KK_ACCESS_TOKEN in .env.
